name: Supernode data centre campus

address.note: From master.csv; QLD cadastre (source 7): 81/83 Kremzow Road = Lot 121 M31114 (16.2 ha). Sources describe a 30 ha site adjacent to South Pine substation. The BESS development permit DA/2023/1419 is mapped on Lot 3 SP213172 (10.0 ha, ~1.4 km south of the 83 Kremzow Rd point), so the campus may span several lots and the Kremzow Road address is unconfirmed.

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '83 Kremzow Road, Brendale QLD 4500' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100).

builder.note: no data centre builder; BESS stages built separately

mw_it.note: up to four hyperscale data centres; per-building IT MW not stated. The 800 MW figure is site power supply capacity from South Pine substation

mw_grid.note: Quinbrook: 'up to 800 MWs of power supply capacity' (via South Pine substation, three HV connections) - site supply capacity, not confirmed DC demand; BESS also uses this connection (780 MW/3,074 MWh BESS campus planned per source 4).

cost_aud_m.note: Quinbrook: 'estimated capital investment of up to $2.5 billion when fully constructed'; QLD Govt: '$2.5 billion-plus'. Includes BESS; no split published. BESS Stage 1 financing $325m; Stage 3 debt financing A$469m (source 4).

authority.note: Quinbrook (8 Jul 2022): obtained 'Foreign Investment Review Board' approval and 'local planning permissions from Moreton Bay Regional Council'. No data centre application identified in council's open DA dataset (source 8).

pathway.note: Type of council permission for the data centres not found. The BESS has its own code-assessable permit: DA/2023/1419 'Reconfiguring a Lot ... Material Change of Use - Development Permit for Battery Storage Facility and Building Works', lodged 2023-04-18, approved 2023-11-17 (source 8) - not the DC approval.

reference.note: DC approval reference not found. DA/36991/2018/V2L (cited by search results for 107-109 Kremzow Road) is a residential/preliminary approval, unrelated. BESS: DA/2023/1419.

determined.note: Approval obtained before the 8 July 2022 launch announcement (Quinbrook release; QLD ministerial statement dated Friday 8 July 2022). Exact date not found.

construction_start.note: Site works began June 2024 for BESS Stage 1 only; no data centre building construction found

construction_end.note: BESS Stage 1 operational Feb 2026; Stage 2 (250 MW/1,040 MWh) operating late Jul 2026; Stage 3 (260 MW/1,216 MWh) financed Aug 2026 (ESS News, read in full). No data centre component mentioned. Data centre timing unknown (Baxtel shows 2028-2031).

open_questions: scope: no evidence any data centre building has been designed, lodged or started; the 2022 'local planning permissions' are unspecified and no DC application appears in council's DA dataset - the approval claim is unverified
per-building IT MW unknown; should split into up to 4 rows once known
council DA reference, type and date for the data centres not found (BESS permit DA/2023/1419 found)
